value.name: receives Daniel's email
value.description: At 5:15, she receives an email from Daniel saying he will not retain separate counsel and will see her Thursday.
evidence: At five-fifteen she got an email from Daniel.
"Counselor — I have thought about your question. I will not be retaining separate counsel. I will see you Thursday. Thank you for yesterday and today. — D. Serrano."

value.name: re-reads email repeatedly
value.description: She reads Daniel's email twice, waits half an hour, and reads it a third time while fixating on the thank-you line.
evidence: She closed the email and opened it again half an hour later and read it a third time.
The thank-you at the end was the line she kept returning to.

value.name: infers Daniel's deliberation
value.description: She interprets the thank-you as a carefully chosen line that Daniel may have revised before sending.
evidence: It was placed where in another man's email it would have been placed without thought, as a closing formula, and where in this man's email she suspected it had been placed and then cut and then replaced, possibly more than once, and that the version she was reading was the version he had decided, after some deliberation, he could stand to have written.

value.name: sends restrained reply
value.description: At six, she replies to Daniel without including a thank-you, choosing not to reciprocate his gratitude.
evidence: "Mr. Serrano — Received. I will see you Thursday at the inspection. — A. Mensah."
She did not include a thank-you.
She wanted, very precisely, to receive his without redeeming him for it.

value.name: leaves office for home
value.description: At seven, she leaves the office and takes the long way home through the city.
evidence: At seven she left the office.
She walked the long way home, west across Market and then north up Twenty-first

value.name: stops for soup alone
value.description: She stops at a small place on Pine for soup and eats alone with her phone face-down beside the bowl.
evidence: she stopped at the little place on Pine for soup, and she ate the soup alone at a small table with her phone face-down beside the bowl

value.name: reflects melancholically
value.description: While eating alone, she falls into a careful, melancholy train of thought.
evidence: and she thought, with the careful and somewhat melancholy attention she gave to such thoughts when she gave them atten
